articles.title: Coinbase eyes World Cup boost as prediction markets surge: Bernstein
articles.snippet: Bernstein says the 2026 FIFA World Cup could inject billions into prediction markets, with Coinbase and Robinhood positioned to capture a wave of new users.

articles.title: AI Agents Still Can't Stop Prompt Injection Attacks, Researchers Warn
articles.snippet: A new benchmark study found AI agents remain vulnerable to prompt injection attacks as companies increasingly roll out the technology to the public.
